answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in trellis, verified in willow, and inlet names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 24 submissions per epoch. A 460 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
